_note: UNTESTED. Same shape as pass3-sky-types.json: per type a "representative" with "PhysicalSky.Day" (flat dotted paths; vector components .x/.y/.z/.w; "cloudLayer.cirrus.weather" is ONE value, the whole {"states": [...]} blend object) and "PhysicalSky.periodOverrides" (per other period only the keys that differ from Day). New in pass 4: fair types (clear, fair, partly) also carry "representativeOppositeMoisture"; feature blocks use "<Setting>.<Period>" keys for all six periods ("ImageBasedLighting", "GroundFog"); "Effects11.notSceneDrivable" is a harness-only proposal; "curveValues" shows the multipliers behind the numbers. "globalOnly" must be set once globally.

globalOnly.why: uvSize and baseRelief.noise are scene-blacklisted; lightning.weatherMode is an integer (not blendable). All three are in the pack Baseline or are code defaults; the sweep files set uvSize and weatherMode in every variant.

notSceneDrivable.Effects11.StandaloneRays / StandaloneSun: catalogue rows are Persisted | Hidden (not transitionable, not scene-controllable) and Effects11 is in no scene whitelist. Values are in "Effects11.notSceneDrivable" per representative and in the *_rays sweeps; set one global strength, or make the keys scene-controllable + whitelist Effects11 for time-of-day scenes.
notSceneDrivable.SkySync.HorizonFadeElevation / HorizonFa: rows are scene-controllable but the SkySync feature is not in kTimeOfDayFeatureWhitelist: global only (saved 1.5; look pack 9.3).
whole features are scene-blacklisted: global only.
notSceneDrivable.PhysicalSky.lightning.weatherMode: Integer row, not transitionable: global only. In the pack Baseline as 0.
notSceneDrivable.PhysicalSky.cloudMap.procedural.paramete: blacklisted integer slot: code default 1 is what the recipes use.
notSceneDrivable.PhysicalSky.aerosolType / aerosolLoading: blacklisted: haze is written as aerosolScatter / aerosolAbsorption coefficients.

moistureRule.formula: moisture = clamp01(type + region + alternate); curve position k = clamp01((moisture - 0.2) / (0.8 - 0.2))

clear.label: Clear
clear.rationale: Pass 3 unchanged (looked good at 13:00 and 17:30). The liked fair-weather cut-off with a higher threshold: a few bold cumulus, small-fragment layer off; sparse high streaks.

fair.label: Fair-weather cumulus
fair.rationale: Pass 3 unchanged (looked good at 13:00 and 17:30). Lightest member = the liked small_fragments 07 look exactly; heavier members lower the threshold a little. Sparse high streaks.

partly.label: Partly cloudy
partly.rationale: Pass 3 unchanged (looked good at 13:00 and 17:30). Same sharp cut-off as fair with a lower threshold (consistent cloud shapes), on the saved 1200 + 900 slab; large streaky high sheets, thinner by day (glare).

overcast.label: Overcast
overcast.rationale: heavy-sky "overcast" recipe at OvercastPF: closed stratocumulus deck (coverage exactly 1), base relief + billows from independent noise, light through the deck by column depth, deck lights the ground. Lighter members higher / thinner / brighter, heavier lower / deeper. Replaces the pass-3 deck that read as a flat even sky.

rain.label: Rain
rain.rationale: heavy-sky "rain" recipe at RainPF: closed nimbostratus at 550 m, darker bases under thick columns. Fully closed for every member (open breaks let the sun through as a bright blob); showers = a higher, thinner, brighter closed deck.

storm.label: Thunderstorm
storm.rationale: heavy-sky "storm" recipe: closed deck, 2000 m slab, largest relief, shortest half depth (darkest bases). Base by severity 500 m (lightest) -> 400 m (StormPF) -> 350 m (StormTU, peaks wrapped). No heightVariation / bottomSpread shaping (the folded bands). Own lightning rate / distance / intensity.

snow.label: Snow
snow.rationale: Light snow under a bright sun (SkuldafnCloudy, SnowClear) = the pass-3 thin broken cloud under a veil, unchanged. Steady snow = heavy-sky "snow" recipe (thin bright closed deck, long half depth, soft base, shallow relief). Blizzard = the same, lower and deeper.

fog.label: Fog
fog.rationale: heavy-sky "fog" recipe: soft closed stratus with its base at 230 m (75 m above the Whiterun plain, hill tops inside), the air below it belongs to Ground Fog (high amounts, almost no burn-off) + haze + height fog as in pass 3.

special.label: Other realm / map
special.rationale: Worldspace is not in the Physical Sky whitelist, so the file most likely never applies; clear values without a high layer.
